title: Vernon Luxury Full Day Boat Tour with Lunch Stop
includes: Cooler with chilled water and room for snacks and drinks
Transport Canada Certified Fun and Friendly Captain!
Sound system to play your favorite music via your phone playlist
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Get Your Okanagan On! This full day all age friendly tour will be the highlight of your trip! 

Your fun and friendly Transport Canada certified captain will greet you to take you for the ultimate day of cruising Okanagan Lake in Style of your private 22ft private luxury pontoon boat! 

Bluetooth your tunes, and take in the Okanagan lifestyle as we cruise past stunning mountainous scenery, monster mansions, and rolling vineyards. Bring snacks and such for a picnic at a beach stop... This day is your to enjoy with friends and family to experience the best vacation ever! We will then cruise back in style back to your pick up dock.
